purpose: Qualify complete inventories, job logs and recipient accounting at the proposed larger populations before repeated performance measurements.

reporting.claim: Larger-population driver and evidence qualification only; timings are diagnostic, not performance or capacity evidence.
reporting.inventory_rule: Count before, fetch every 500-row page, require an empty terminal page, count again, reject duplicated IDs or any count change. Retain every raw response. These REST inventories are collected while workload mutation is stopped; SQL reconciliation is a separate cloud gate.
reporting.failure_rule: Retain all attempts, transport and HTTP failures, missing recipients, changed controls and incomplete batch jobs. No mutation is retried.
reporting.limit_rule: The 120-second recipient and 240-second batch-terminal limits are fixed before this qualification. They are not production service levels or changes to the earlier small qualification.

required_before_execution: verified fresh equivalent state per cell
